description: This file contains a helper class for generating JWT tokens for test users, including methods for creating admin and normal user tokens, primarily used in integration testing scenarios.

classes.name: ApiTokenHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to generate JWT tokens for testing purposes, simulating admin and normal users.

methods.name: GetAdminUserToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for an admin user with predefined email and role.

methods.name: GetNormalUserToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for a normal user with a predefined email.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Internal method that constructs a JWT token with specified userName and roles.
